xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:RelatedPartyTransactionExplana: Notes to Related party transactions for the half year ended 30th September, 2026: 1. Loans advanced and repayments received during the reporting period have been reported on net basis. 2. Opening and closing balances have not been disclosed where there were no transactions relating to investments or impairment during the half-year ended 30 September 2026 3. Foreign currency transactions have been translated at the average exchange rate for the period, and related balances at the exchange rates prevailing on the respective reporting dates. 4. Interest rates disclosed for loans are the rates applicable as at 30 September 2026. 5. Audit Committee approvals granted in foreign currency have been translated into Indian rupees using the exchange rate prevailing on 30 September 2026 6. Transactions with employees of the parent company who are appointed as directors or KMPs of subsidiary companies have not been separately disclosed where such transactions arise solely under their terms of employment with the parent company 7. Post employment benefits are actuarially determined on an overall basis and are therefore not separately identified. 8. Kalpataru IBN Omairah Company Limited was renamed Kalpataru Projects Arabia Company with effect from 14 April 2026 9. The Company acquired the remaining 35% equity interest in Kalpataru Projects Arabia Company on 14 April 2026. Consequently, it became a wholly owned subsidiary from that date. 10. Amounts below Rs. 50,000 have been rounded off to NIL.
